feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer, fines team $30M, Kawhi Leonard $700K in cap circumvention case
entry.summary: Los Angeles Clippers owner Steve Ballmer was suspended for one year by the NBA, and the team was ordered to pay $30 million for violating salary cap circumvention rules in a case involving Kawhi Leonard.

entry.title: Cassandra Wilson, Grammy-winning jazz vocalist, dies at 70
entry.summary: Wilson, whose deep, dark contralto was one of the most distinctive voices in jazz, died on Wednesday in her hometown of Jackson, Miss.

entry.title: The IRS slashed its staff. One result? More taxes going uncollected
entry.summary: The IRS slashed its auditing staff last year — but the move may have backfired as tax collections from enforcement efforts plummeted, an Inspector General report shows.

entry.title: A jury in Malta acquits a businessman in the killing of reporter Daphne Caruana Galizia
entry.summary: Investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia had written extensively about suspected corruption in political and business circles in Malta. She was killed by a car bomb in 2017, at age 53.

entry.title: Olivia Rodrigo's women-led Daisy Chain Fields festival put the power in fans' hands
entry.summary: The inaugural edition of Rodrigo's one-day, women-led concert, which featured artists like Stevie Nicks, Sarah McLachlan and Chappell Roan, didn't sideline its stated political mission.

entry.title: New Jersey asks Supreme Court to resolve fight over Kalshi's future
entry.summary: If the high court accepts the petition, it would tee up a case with sweeping implications for prediction markets, an industry that has unleashed billions of dollars of betting across nearly every aspect of modern life.

entry.title: New immigration court tactic leads to huge lines and chaos in Miami
entry.summary: Chaos unfolds at the Miami immigration court after judges are assigned mega master calendars, hearings where judges see more than 100 immigrants at once.

entry.title: Iran fires on its Gulf neighbors, retaliating for U.S. strikes after a monthlong lull
entry.summary: The six-month war has led to a spike in oil prices, roiled the global economy and posed increasing political problems for President Trump's Republican Party ahead of November midterm elections.

entry.title: Greetings from the Royal Pavilion, a stunning reminder of India in southern England
entry.summary: Looking up at this 18th century building, it became clear the British didn't only bring their architectural style to India. They also took some of India's style home.

entry.title: Chevron to expand in Venezuela, days after the U.S. and Venezuela strike oil deal
entry.summary: Chevron is the largest foreign oil operator in Venezuela. The deal will expand its footprint at a time of political and economic uncertainty for Venezuela.
